name: nifty50-ml-trading-app
description: Merged NIFTY 50 ML Trading dashboard: React/Vite frontend + FastAPI ML backend, run together with `npm run dev`.

scripts.install:backend: (if exist .venv\Scripts\python.exe (.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pip install --upgrade pip && .venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pip install -r backend/requirements.txt) else if exist ..\.venv\Scripts\python.exe (..\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pip install --upgrade pip && ..\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pip install -r backend/requirements.txt) else (python -m pip install --upgrade pip && python -m pip install -r backend/requirements.txt))
scripts.setup: npm run install:frontend && npm run install:backend
